title: A Small Change in the Morning

sentences.en: Lily used to wake up at eight and rush to class without breakfast.
sentences.zh: 莉莉过去常常八点起床，不吃早饭就赶去上课。

sentences.en: Last month she started a new plan.
sentences.zh: 上个月她开始了一个新计划。

sentences.en: Now she gets up at seven and eats a simple meal at home.
sentences.zh: 现在她七点起床，在家吃一顿简单的饭。

sentences.en: The meal is easy to make.
sentences.zh: 这顿饭做起来很容易。

sentences.en: She cooks an egg, washes an apple, and drinks a glass of warm water.
sentences.zh: 她煎一个鸡蛋，洗一个苹果，再喝一杯温水。

sentences.en: It takes her only ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 这只需要她十分钟。

sentences.en: At first, the early hour felt hard.
sentences.zh: 一开始，那么早起床让她觉得很难受。

sentences.en: She set two alarms on her phone.
sentences.zh: 她在手机上设了两个闹钟。

sentences.en: After a week, her body got used to the new time.
sentences.zh: 一周之后，她的身体习惯了这个新时间。

sentences.en: Now Lily feels more awake in her first class.
sentences.zh: 现在莉莉在第一节课上清醒多了。

sentences.en: She also saves money because she no longer buys food on the way.
sentences.zh: 她也省了钱，因为她不再在路上买吃的。

sentences.en: She says the small change was worth the effort.
sentences.zh: 她说这个小小的改变值得付出。

keyVocab.note: rush to + 地点，表示赶着去某处
常修饰 meal、plan、idea 等
set an alarm 表示设定闹钟
feel awake 表示感觉清醒
be worth + 名词，表示值得某事

grammar.en: She cooks an egg, washes an apple, and drinks a glass of warm water.
grammar.main: She cooks an egg, washes an apple, and drinks a glass of water
grammar.subject: She
grammar.object: an egg / an apple / a glass of water
grammar.modifiers: warm 是形容词，修饰 water；a glass of 表示数量
grammar.logic: 三个动词用逗号和 and 并列，按时间顺序说明做早餐的三个动作
grammar.zh: 她煎一个鸡蛋，洗一个苹果，再喝一杯温水。

grammar.en: She also saves money because she no longer buys food on the way.
grammar.main: She saves money
grammar.subject: She
grammar.object: money
grammar.modifiers: because 引导原因状语从句；on the way 是介词短语，表示在路上
grammar.logic: 先说结果（省钱），再说原因（不再在路上买吃的）
grammar.zh: 她也省了钱，因为她不再在路上买吃的。

grammar.en: After a week, her body got used to the new time.
grammar.main: her body got used to the new time
grammar.subject: her body
grammar.object: the new time
grammar.modifiers: After a week 是介词短语，作时间状语，放在句首
grammar.logic: 时间状语放句首，先交代时间，再说身体适应了新作息
grammar.zh: 一周之后，她的身体习惯了这个新时间。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A way to make money fast
quiz.evidence: Now she gets up at seven and eats a simple meal at home.
quiz.explain: 全文都在讲莉莉如何改变早晨的安排，以及这个改变带来的好处，所以主旨是她的晨间新习惯。
whyWrong: 文中没有任何烹饪课的内容。
省钱只是附带的好处，文章重点不是赚钱。
文中没有写到去超市买东西的经历。

quiz.question: How long does it take Lily to make her breakfast?
quiz.evidence: It takes her only ten minutes.
quiz.explain: 原文直接给出时间：做这顿早餐只花她十分钟。
whyWrong: 五分钟比原文说的时间短。
二十分钟比原文说的时间长。
半小时远远超过文中提到的时间。

quiz.question: What does the word 'rush' in paragraph 1 most probably mean?
quiz.evidence: Lily used to wake up at eight and rush to class without breakfast.
quiz.explain: 八点才起床又要赶去上课，还要不吃早饭，说明动作很急，rush 指匆忙快步走。
whyWrong: 慢慢吃与赶时间的语境相反。
睡到很晚是她过去的状态，不能解释 rush 的意思。
rush 描述的是走路的样子，与学习努力无关。

quiz.question: Why does Lily save money now?
options: She cooks at home instead of buying food outside.
She walks to class every day.
She gets money from her parents.
She eats much less than before.
quiz.evidence: She also saves money because she no longer buys food on the way.
quiz.explain: 原文说省下的原因是她不再在路上买吃的，也就是改成在家做饭。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到她每天步行去上课。
父母给钱这件事在文中完全没有出现。
她并没有少吃，只是换了吃饭的地方。

title: Ten Thousand Steps

sentences.en: Many people in China wear a small band on their wrist that counts steps.
sentences.zh: 中国很多人手腕上戴着一个小手环，用来计步。

sentences.en: They check the number on their phone every evening.
sentences.zh: 他们每天晚上在手机上查看这个数字。

sentences.en: Ten thousand steps a day has become a popular goal.
sentences.zh: 每天一万步已经成为一个流行的目标。

sentences.en: Walking is easy and safe for most people.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，走路既简单又安全。

sentences.en: You do not need a gym or special clothes.
sentences.zh: 你不需要健身房，也不需要专门的服装。

sentences.en: A quick walk after dinner can also help you sleep better.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后快走一会儿还能帮你睡得更好。

sentences.en: However, ten thousand is not a magic number.
sentences.zh: 不过，一万并不是一个神奇的数字。

sentences.en: It came from an old advertisement in Japan, not from medical research.
sentences.zh: 它来自日本的一则旧广告，而不是医学研究。

sentences.en: For older people, six thousand steps may be enough.
sentences.zh: 对年纪大的人来说，六千步也许就够了。

sentences.en: Doctors say the best plan is the one you can keep.
sentences.zh: 医生说，最好的计划是你能坚持下来的那个。

sentences.en: Walking to the bus stop or climbing the stairs still counts.
sentences.zh: 走到公交站或者爬楼梯，同样算数。

sentences.en: The goal is to move a little more than last week.
sentences.zh: 目标是比上周多动一点。

keyVocab.note: 此处既指计步，也指算作有效运动
set a goal 表示设定目标
go to the gym 表示去健身
常缩写为 ad
medical research 医学研究
常用复数，climb the stairs 爬楼梯

grammar.en: They check the number on their phone every evening.
grammar.main: They check the number
grammar.subject: They
grammar.object: the number
grammar.modifiers: on their phone 是介词短语，说明在哪里看；every evening 是时间状语
grammar.logic: 先说做什么，再补地点和时间，这是英语最常见的语序
grammar.zh: 他们每天晚上在手机上查看这个数字。

grammar.en: It came from an old advertisement in Japan, not from medical research.
grammar.main: It came from an old advertisement
grammar.subject: It
grammar.object: an old advertisement
grammar.modifiers: in Japan 是介词短语，修饰 advertisement；not from medical research 是对前一半的否定补充
grammar.logic: 先用肯定说明来源，再用 not 否定另一个来源，纠正读者的想当然
grammar.zh: 它来自日本的一则旧广告，而不是医学研究。

grammar.en: Walking to the bus stop or climbing the stairs still counts.
grammar.main: Walking to the bus stop or climbing the stairs counts
grammar.subject: Walking to the bus stop or climbing the stairs
grammar.object: 无宾语（counts 在这里是不及物动词，意为算数）
grammar.modifiers: to the bus stop 是介词短语，修饰 walking
grammar.logic: 动名词短语作主语，or 连接两种日常活动，说明它们都有效
grammar.zh: 走到公交站或者爬楼梯，同样算数。

quiz.question: Where did the goal of ten thousand steps come from?
quiz.evidence: It came from an old advertisement in Japan, not from medical research.
quiz.explain: 原文明确指出这个数字来自日本的一则旧广告，并且特别否定了医学研究这一来源。
whyWrong: 原文用 not 明确排除了医学研究。
文中没有提到任何跑步比赛。
学校规定与这个数字的来源无关。

quiz.question: What does the word 'magic' mean in paragraph 3?
options: A number that works for everyone
A number used in card games
A number shown by a phone app
A number that changes every day
quiz.evidence: However, ten thousand is not a magic number.
quiz.explain: 后文说老人六千步就够，说明作者想表达一万并非对所有人都适用的万能数字。
whyWrong: 文中谈的是运动量，不是纸牌游戏。
手机应用只是记录工具，与 magic 的含义无关。
这个数字是固定的，不会每天变化。

quiz.question: What does the writer think about the ten thousand step goal?
options: It is the only way to stay healthy.
It is useful but not right for everyone.
It is a complete waste of time.
It should be raised to twenty thousand.
quiz.evidence: Doctors say the best plan is the one you can keep.
quiz.explain: 作者先肯定走路的好处，再指出一万步并非人人适用，最后强调能坚持的计划才是最好的。
whyWrong: 作者说老人六千步就够，可见并非唯一标准。
作者认为走路很有用，并没有否定这项运动。
文中从未提出要提高步数目标。

quiz.question: Why does the writer mention walking to the bus stop?
options: To show that small daily walks also count.
To explain how to take a bus.
To say that walking outside is dangerous.
quiz.evidence: Walking to the bus stop or climbing the stairs still counts.
quiz.explain: 作者举出生活中不起眼的走路机会，是为了说明不必刻意凑步数，日常活动同样有效。
whyWrong: 文章不是交通指南，没有讲怎么坐公交。
文中没有把公交和汽车作比较。
作者认为走路安全，并未说危险。

title: The Library After Class

sentences.en: Our school library opens until nine in the evening.
sentences.zh: 我们学校的图书馆开到晚上九点。

sentences.en: Many students go there after their last class.
sentences.zh: 很多学生在最后一节课后去那里。

sentences.en: The reading room is quiet, and the seats near the window fill up first.
sentences.zh: 阅览室很安静，靠窗的座位最先坐满。

sentences.en: Zhang Wei goes there three times a week.
sentences.zh: 张伟每周去那里三次。

sentences.en: He does not read novels.
sentences.zh: 他并不是去读小说。

sentences.en: He works on his math homework because his roommates talk a lot in the dormitory.
sentences.zh: 他去做数学作业，因为室友在宿舍里说话很多。

sentences.en: The library also offers free help.
sentences.zh: 图书馆还提供免费帮助。

sentences.en: Every Tuesday, a teacher sits at a small desk and answers questions about writing.
sentences.zh: 每周二，一位老师坐在一张小桌子旁，回答关于写作的问题。

sentences.en: Students can bring one page and get advice in fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 学生可以带一页纸来，十五分钟内得到建议。

sentences.en: For Zhang Wei, the library is not just a place for books.
sentences.zh: 对张伟来说，图书馆不只是一个放书的地方。

sentences.en: It is a quiet place to think.
sentences.zh: 它是一个可以安静思考的地方。

sentences.en: He says his grades are better this term.
sentences.zh: 他说这学期他的成绩更好了。

keyVocab.note: keep quiet 表示保持安静
fill up 表示装满、坐满
常缩写为 dorm
不可数名词，不说 an advice
常用复数 grades 表示各科成绩

grammar.en: Many students go there after their last class.
grammar.main: Many students go there
grammar.subject: Many students
grammar.object: 无宾语（there 是副词，作地点状语）
grammar.modifiers: after their last class 是介词短语，作时间状语
grammar.logic: 先给主句，再用介词短语交代时间，顺序与中文一致
grammar.zh: 很多学生在最后一节课后去那里。

grammar.en: The reading room is quiet, and the seats near the window fill up first.
grammar.main: The reading room is quiet, and the seats fill up first
grammar.subject: The reading room / the seats
grammar.object: 无宾语（is 后是表语 quiet；fill up 此处不及物）
grammar.modifiers: near the window 是介词短语，放在名词后修饰 the seats
grammar.logic: and 连接两个地位平等的分句，第二个分句补充具体细节
grammar.zh: 阅览室很安静，靠窗的座位最先坐满。

grammar.en: He works on his math homework because his roommates talk a lot in the dormitory.
grammar.main: He works on his math homework
grammar.subject: He
grammar.object: his math homework
grammar.modifiers: because 引导原因状语从句；in the dormitory 是地点状语
grammar.logic: 主句说做法，because 从句解释原因
grammar.zh: 他做数学作业，因为室友在宿舍里说话很多。

quiz.question: How often does Zhang Wei go to the library?
quiz.evidence: Zhang Wei goes there three times a week.
quiz.explain: 原文直接说明他每周去三次，这是一个明确的频度细节。
whyWrong: 文中说的是每周三次，不是每天。
每月一次比原文的频度低得多。
周二只是老师答疑的日子，不是他去的次数。

quiz.question: Why does Zhang Wei study in the library instead of his room?
options: He has no desk at home.
quiz.evidence: He works on his math homework because his roommates talk a lot in the dormitory.
quiz.explain: 原文用 because 说明原因：室友在宿舍里说话很多，所以他需要换个安静的地方。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到宿舍房间的大小。
图书馆有免费咖啡这一点完全没有出现。
文中说的是室友吵，不是没有书桌。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A library that helps students after class
The history of a school building
How to write a good essay
quiz.evidence: Our school library opens until nine in the evening.
quiz.explain: 全文介绍图书馆的开放时间、学生的使用情况和免费的写作答疑，主题是课后帮助学生的地方。
whyWrong: 文中没有任何关于建筑历史的内容。
写作只是答疑的一个话题，文章并不教写作方法。
老师只在文中出现一次，不是全文主题。

quiz.question: What does the phrase 'fill up' mean in paragraph 1?
quiz.evidence: The reading room is quiet, and the seats near the window fill up first.
quiz.explain: 座位先 fill up，意思是先被坐满，所以这个词组表示变满。
whyWrong: 打扫与座位被占满的意思无关。
坏掉不符合座位受欢迎这一语境。
移开与读者抢座的情形相反。

title: Tea in Two Countries

sentences.en: My British teacher once made tea for our class.
sentences.zh: 我的英国老师曾给我们班泡过一次茶。

sentences.en: She put a tea bag in a cup, added hot water, and then poured in milk.
sentences.zh: 她把茶包放进杯子，倒热水，然后加牛奶。

sentences.en: Some students were surprised, because we never put milk in tea at home.
sentences.zh: 有些学生很惊讶，因为我们在家从来不往茶里加牛奶。

sentences.en: In China, tea is usually drunk plain.
sentences.zh: 在中国，茶通常是清饮的。

sentences.en: People care about the smell and the colour of the water.
sentences.zh: 人们在意味道和茶汤的颜色。

sentences.en: A small cup is filled again and again during a talk.
sentences.zh: 聊天时，一个小杯子会被一次次斟满。

sentences.en: In Britain, tea is often a short break.
sentences.zh: 在英国，茶常常意味着一次短暂的休息。

sentences.en: People drink it with milk, sugar, or biscuits.
sentences.zh: 人们会配着牛奶、糖或者饼干喝茶。

sentences.en: The drink is less about the tea leaf and more about the rest.
sentences.zh: 这杯饮料与其说关乎茶叶，不如说关乎休息。

sentences.en: Both habits show the same idea.
sentences.zh: 两种习惯体现了同一个想法。

sentences.en: A cup of tea gives people a reason to stop and sit together.
sentences.zh: 一杯茶给了人们一个停下来、坐在一起的理由。

sentences.en: The taste is different, but the feeling is close.
sentences.zh: 味道不同，感受却很接近。

keyVocab.note: drink tea plain 表示清饮，不加奶糖
pour in 表示倒入
英式拼写，美式写作 color
英式说法，美式常用 cookie
复数为 leaves，tea leaves 指茶叶

grammar.en: She put a tea bag in a cup, added hot water, and then poured in milk.
grammar.main: She put a tea bag in a cup, added hot water, and poured in milk
grammar.subject: She
grammar.object: a tea bag / hot water / milk
grammar.modifiers: in a cup 是介词短语，表示位置；then 表示动作的先后
grammar.logic: 三个过去式动词并列，按实际动作顺序排列
grammar.zh: 她把茶包放进杯子，倒热水，然后加牛奶。

grammar.en: Some students were surprised, because we never put milk in tea at home.
grammar.main: Some students were surprised
grammar.subject: Some students
grammar.object: 无宾语（were surprised 是系表结构）
grammar.modifiers: because 引导原因状语从句；at home 是地点状语
grammar.logic: 先说反应，再解释为什么会有这种反应
grammar.zh: 有些学生很惊讶，因为我们在家从来不往茶里加牛奶。

grammar.en: A cup of tea gives people a reason to stop and sit together.
grammar.main: A cup of tea gives people a reason
grammar.subject: A cup of tea
grammar.object: people / a reason（双宾语）
grammar.modifiers: to stop and sit together 是不定式，放在 reason 后面修饰它
grammar.logic: give sb sth 的双宾语结构，说明茶给了人们什么
grammar.zh: 一杯茶给了人们一个停下来、坐在一起的理由。

quiz.question: What did the teacher add to the tea?
quiz.evidence: She put a tea bag in a cup, added hot water, and then poured in milk.
quiz.explain: 原文按顺序写了三个动作，最后加入的是牛奶。
whyWrong: 文中没有出现柠檬。
蜂蜜在文中完全没有提到。
盐与泡茶的过程无关。

quiz.question: What does the word 'plain' mean in paragraph 2?
quiz.evidence: In China, tea is usually drunk plain.
quiz.explain: 这一段紧接着上文加牛奶的对比，说中国人喝茶不加别的东西，所以 plain 指清饮、不添加。
whyWrong: 很甜与清饮的意思正好相反。
很烫说的是温度，不是加不加东西。
下文说的是小杯子，与 plain 的含义无关。

quiz.question: Why were some students surprised?
options: They never put milk in tea at home.
quiz.evidence: Some students were surprised, because we never put milk in tea at home.
quiz.explain: 原文用 because 说明惊讶的来源：学生们在自己家里从没这样喝过茶。
whyWrong: 原文用的是热水，不是冷水。
杯子的确是小杯，但这是后文的内容，不是惊讶的原因。
文中没有提到茶的价格。

quiz.question: What does the writer want to say in the last paragraph?
options: Tea habits in the two countries share a similar meaning.
British tea is better than Chinese tea.
Milk tea is a new fashion.
quiz.evidence: The taste is different, but the feeling is close.
quiz.explain: 作者说味道不同但感受接近，强调两种喝茶方式背后的共同点。
whyWrong: 作者只做对比，没有评判哪种更好。
作者显然欣赏喝茶，不会劝人放弃。
奶茶不是本文讨论的对象。

title: One Bag, Many Times

sentences.en: Every time you buy a drink, the shop gives you a plastic bag.
sentences.zh: 每次你买饮料，商店都会给你一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: Most of these bags are used for about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 这些袋子大多只被用上二十分钟左右。

sentences.en: Then they become rubbish.
sentences.zh: 然后它们就变成了垃圾。

sentences.en: A plastic bag does not disappear quickly.
sentences.zh: 塑料袋不会很快消失。

sentences.en: It can stay in the soil for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 它能在土壤里留存几百年。

sentences.en: Birds and fish sometimes eat small pieces and become sick.
sentences.zh: 鸟和鱼有时会吃下小碎片，然后生病。

sentences.en: Last year, a supermarket in my city decided to try something new.
sentences.zh: 去年，我所在城市的一家超市决定尝试一个新办法。

sentences.en: Customers could bring their own cloth bags and get five points.
sentences.zh: 顾客可以带自己的布袋，从而得到五个积分。

sentences.en: In three months, the shop used thirty percent fewer plastic bags.
sentences.zh: 三个月内，这家店少用了百分之三十的塑料袋。

sentences.en: A cloth bag is not perfect either.
sentences.zh: 布袋也不是完美的。

sentences.en: You need to use it many times before it helps the environment.
sentences.zh: 你需要用很多次，它才能真正对环境有帮助。

sentences.en: The real answer is simple: use less, and use it longer.
sentences.zh: 真正的答案很简单：少用一点，用久一点。

keyVocab.note: 英式说法，美式常用 garbage 或 trash
由 appear 加否定前缀 dis- 构成
比 earth 更强调可种植的表层土
thirty percent 百分之三十
protect the environment 保护环境

grammar.en: It can stay in the soil for hundreds of years.
grammar.main: It can stay in the soil
grammar.subject: It
grammar.object: 无宾语（stay 是不及物动词）
grammar.modifiers: in the soil 是地点状语；for hundreds of years 是介词短语，表示持续时间
grammar.logic: 情态动词 can 加动词原形，表示一种可能性
grammar.zh: 它能在土壤里留存几百年。

grammar.en: Customers could bring their own cloth bags and get five points.
grammar.main: Customers could bring their own cloth bags and get five points
grammar.subject: Customers
grammar.object: their own cloth bags / five points
grammar.modifiers: their own 强调是顾客自己的袋子，与店里提供的形成对比
grammar.logic: and 连接两个并列谓语，前一个动作带来后一个结果
grammar.zh: 顾客可以带自己的布袋，从而得到五个积分。

grammar.en: You need to use it many times before it helps the environment.
grammar.main: You need to use it many times
grammar.subject: You
grammar.object: to use it many times（不定式作宾语）
grammar.modifiers: before 引导时间状语从句，表示在……之前
grammar.logic: before 从句实际上提出了条件：先多次使用，才谈得上环保
grammar.zh: 你需要用很多次，它才能真正对环境有帮助。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why plastic bags are a problem and what can help
How to make cloth bags at home
How birds find food in cities
quiz.evidence: The real answer is simple: use less, and use it longer.
quiz.explain: 文章先说塑料袋使用时间短却污染久，再讲超市的尝试，最后给出减少使用的结论，主题是问题与对策。
whyWrong: 文中没有教人怎么制作布袋。
超市只是举例，不是文章的历史主题。
鸟吃塑料只是说明危害的一个例子。

quiz.question: What did customers get if they brought their own bags?
quiz.evidence: Customers could bring their own cloth bags and get five points.
quiz.explain: 原文明确说带自己的布袋可以得到五个积分。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到赠送饮料。
给的是积分，不是十元钱。
布袋是顾客自己带来的，不是店里发的。

quiz.question: Why is a cloth bag not always better?
options: It only helps after it is used many times.
quiz.evidence: You need to use it many times before it helps the environment.
quiz.explain: 布袋在生产时也有消耗，所以原文强调要用很多次，它的环保效果才体现出来。
whyWrong: 文中没有讨论布袋的价格。
文中没有说布袋不好携带。
承重问题在文中完全没有提到。

quiz.question: What does the word 'rubbish' mean in paragraph 1?
quiz.evidence: Then they become rubbish.
quiz.explain: 袋子只用二十分钟就被丢弃，接下来自然变成没人要的垃圾，所以 rubbish 指废弃物。
whyWrong: 用过的袋子不会再拿去卖。
塑料袋不是食物。
上下文与动物无关。

title: The Two Minute Rule

sentences.en: I often plan to study at seven, but I start at nine.
sentences.zh: 我常常计划七点学习，结果九点才开始。

sentences.en: The problem is not time.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于时间。

sentences.en: The problem is the first step.
sentences.zh: 问题在于第一步。

sentences.en: Last week I read about a small trick.
sentences.zh: 上周我读到一个小的窍门。

sentences.en: It is called the two minute rule.
sentences.zh: 它叫做两分钟法则。

sentences.en: You promise yourself to do the task for only two minutes.
sentences.zh: 你向自己承诺，只做这件事两分钟。

sentences.en: On Monday I decided to try it with my English words.
sentences.zh: 周一我决定用英语单词试一试。

sentences.en: I told myself, just open the book and read for two minutes.
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，就打开书读两分钟。

sentences.en: After two minutes, I did not want to stop, and I studied for forty.
sentences.zh: 两分钟之后，我不想停了，结果我学了四十分钟。

sentences.en: The rule works because starting is harder than continuing.
sentences.zh: 这个法则有效，因为开始比坚持更难。

sentences.en: A small promise is easy to keep.
sentences.zh: 一个小小的承诺很容易守住。

sentences.en: Once you begin, your mind stays with the work.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始了，心思就会留在工作上。

sentences.en: It is a small key, but it opens a heavy door.
sentences.zh: 它是一把小钥匙，却能打开一扇沉重的门。

keyVocab.note: a small trick 表示一个小办法
promise yourself 向自己保证
finish a task 完成任务
后接动名词或不定式均可
引导时间状语从句，表示条件

grammar.en: The rule works because starting is harder than continuing.
grammar.main: The rule works
grammar.subject: The rule
grammar.object: 无宾语（works 在此不及物）
grammar.modifiers: because 引导原因状语从句；than continuing 是比较结构
grammar.logic: 主句给结论，从句给原因，比较结构点出难在哪里
grammar.zh: 这个法则有效，因为开始比坚持更难。

grammar.en: After two minutes, I did not want to stop, and I studied for forty.
grammar.main: I did not want to stop, and I studied for forty
grammar.subject: I / I
grammar.object: to stop / 无宾语（for forty 后省略了 minutes）
grammar.modifiers: After two minutes 是时间状语；for forty 表示持续四十分钟
grammar.logic: and 连接两个并列分句，第二个分句是第一个的结果
grammar.zh: 两分钟之后，我不想停了，结果我学了四十分钟。

grammar.en: A small promise is easy to keep.
grammar.main: A small promise is easy to keep
grammar.subject: A small promise
grammar.object: 无宾语（is easy 是系表结构）
grammar.modifiers: to keep 是不定式，放在形容词后面补充说明在哪方面容易
grammar.logic: 主语加系动词加形容词，再用不定式把意思补完整
grammar.zh: 一个小小的承诺很容易守住。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A small method that helps people start studying
How to make a weekly study plan
Why English words are hard to remember
quiz.evidence: It is called the two minute rule.
quiz.explain: 文章介绍两分钟法则，并用自己背单词的经历说明它如何解决难以开始的问题。
whyWrong: 文中没有教人做周计划。
英语单词只是作者试验的对象，不是主题。
作者只是读到一个小方法，并没有介绍某本书。

quiz.question: How long did the writer study on Monday?
quiz.evidence: After two minutes, I did not want to stop, and I studied for forty.
quiz.explain: 原文说他原本只打算读两分钟，结果一直学了四十分钟。
whyWrong: 两分钟只是最初的承诺，不是实际时长。
十分钟在文中没有出现。
两小时远远超过实际时间。

quiz.question: Why does the two minute rule work?
options: Because starting is the hardest part.
Because two minutes is enough to learn.
Because teachers ask students to use it.
quiz.evidence: The rule works because starting is harder than continuing.
quiz.explain: 原文解释了原理：难的是开始，一旦开始，人往往愿意继续下去。
whyWrong: 两分钟学不到多少东西，作者自己也学成了四十分钟。
省纸与这个方法毫无关系。
文中没有提到老师的要求。

quiz.question: What does the word 'trick' mean in paragraph 2?
options: A clever way to do something
quiz.evidence: Last week I read about a small trick.
quiz.explain: 下文介绍的是一个解决拖延的小办法，所以 trick 指巧妙的做法，而不是玩笑。
whyWrong: 这里没有捉弄人的意思。
后文给出的不是难题，而是办法。
文章与纸牌游戏无关。

title: A Map in Your Pocket

sentences.en: Twenty years ago, my father used a paper map in the car.
sentences.zh: 二十年前，我父亲在车里用一张纸质地图。

sentences.en: The map was big and hard to fold.
sentences.zh: 那张地图很大，也很难折起来。

sentences.en: He stopped at a gas station to ask the way.
sentences.zh: 他在加油站停下来问路。

sentences.en: Today I open a map app, and a voice tells me where to turn.
sentences.zh: 现在我打开地图应用，一个声音会告诉我该在哪里转弯。

sentences.en: The app knows where I am because my phone talks to satellites.
sentences.zh: 这个应用知道我在哪里，因为我的手机在和卫星通信。

sentences.en: It also collects reports from other drivers.
sentences.zh: 它还会收集其他司机提供的报告。

sentences.en: When many phones move slowly on one road, the app shows a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 当很多手机在同一条路上移动缓慢时，应用就会显示堵车。

sentences.en: This is useful, but it has a cost.
sentences.zh: 这很有用，但也有代价。

sentences.en: The app needs my location all the time.
sentences.zh: 这个应用一直需要我的位置。

sentences.en: Some people feel uncomfortable when a company knows every place they visit.
sentences.zh: 当一家公司知道他们去过的每个地方时，有些人会感到不舒服。

sentences.en: I still use the app every day.
sentences.zh: 我仍然每天使用这个应用。

sentences.en: But I turn off the location service when I do not need it.
sentences.zh: 但在不需要的时候，我会关掉定位服务。

sentences.en: A good tool should help us, not watch us.
sentences.zh: 好的工具应该帮助我们，而不是监视我们。

keyVocab.note: fold a map 把地图折起来
手机定位依靠卫星信号
collect data 收集数据
location service 定位服务
由 comfortable 加 un- 构成

grammar.en: He stopped at a gas station to ask the way.
grammar.main: He stopped at a gas station
grammar.subject: He
grammar.object: 无宾语（stopped 在此不及物）
grammar.modifiers: at a gas station 是地点状语；to ask the way 是不定式，表示目的
grammar.logic: 先说动作，再用不定式说明目的，回答为什么停下来
grammar.zh: 他在加油站停下来问路。

grammar.en: The app knows where I am because my phone talks to satellites.
grammar.main: The app knows where I am
grammar.subject: The app
grammar.object: where I am（宾语从句）
grammar.modifiers: because 引导原因状语从句，解释应用为什么知道位置
grammar.logic: 主句说结果，because 从句说原因，因果顺序清楚
grammar.zh: 这个应用知道我在哪里，因为我的手机在和卫星通信。

grammar.en: When many phones move slowly on one road, the app shows a traffic jam.
grammar.main: the app shows a traffic jam
grammar.subject: the app
grammar.object: a traffic jam
grammar.modifiers: When 引导时间状语从句，放在句首；on one road 是地点状语
grammar.logic: 先给条件，再给结果，这是英语说明原理时常用的顺序
grammar.zh: 当很多手机在同一条路上移动缓慢时，应用就会显示堵车。

quiz.question: How does the app know where the driver is?
options: The driver types the address first.
A paper map is scanned by the phone.
The car has a small camera.
quiz.evidence: The app knows where I am because my phone talks to satellites.
quiz.explain: 原文用 because 说明定位的原理：手机与卫星通信。
whyWrong: 输入地址是查路线，不是确定当前位置的方法。
文中没有扫描纸质地图的说法。
车载摄像头在文中没有出现。

quiz.question: How does the app learn about a traffic jam?
options: Many phones on one road move slowly.
Drivers send letters to the app.
The app reads the morning news.
quiz.evidence: When many phones move slowly on one road, the app shows a traffic jam.
quiz.explain: 应用通过大量手机在同一路段移动缓慢这一现象，判断那里发生了堵车。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到警察打电话。
司机寄信这种说法完全不符合语境。
应用靠手机数据，不靠读新闻。

quiz.question: What is the writer's idea about map apps?
options: They are helpful but should be used with care.
They are better than building new roads.
They cost too much for most people.
quiz.evidence: A good tool should help us, not watch us.
quiz.explain: 作者一边每天使用应用，一边关掉不必要的定位，态度是接受但要留心。
whyWrong: 作者自己每天都在用，并没有主张停用。
文中没有把应用和修路作比较。
文章说的 cost 指隐私代价，不是使用费用。

quiz.question: What does the word 'cost' mean in paragraph 3?
options: A price you pay, here not in money
A short rest on the road
A loud sound from the phone
quiz.evidence: This is useful, but it has a cost.
quiz.explain: 后文讲的是位置被一直获取、公司知道你去过哪里，可见这里的代价指隐私上的付出，而不是钱。
whyWrong: 本段没有提到在路边休息。
纸质地图是上一段的内容，与 cost 无关。
手机的声音不是这句话要表达的意思。

title: The Bench at the Gate

sentences.en: At the gate of our neighbourhood, there is an old wooden bench.
sentences.zh: 在我们小区门口，有一条旧木长椅。

sentences.en: Nobody knows who put it there.
sentences.zh: 没人知道是谁把它放在那里的。

sentences.en: For many years, it was only a place to wait for a bus.
sentences.zh: 很多年里，它只是一个等公交车的地方。

sentences.en: Two summers ago, an old man began to sit there every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 两年前的夏天，一位老人开始每天下午坐在那里。

sentences.en: He brought a thermos of tea and a small radio.
sentences.zh: 他带来一壶茶和一个小收音机。

sentences.en: Soon other people stopped to talk with him.
sentences.zh: 很快，其他人也停下来和他聊天。

sentences.en: Now the bench is busy.
sentences.zh: 现在这条长椅很热闹。

sentences.en: Children do homework on one end, and neighbours share vegetables at the other.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在一头写作业，邻居们在另一头分菜。

sentences.en: Someone even fixed the broken leg last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月甚至有人把坏掉的椅腿修好了。

sentences.en: The city builds parks and squares, and they are important.
sentences.zh: 城市建设公园和广场，这些很重要。

sentences.en: But a bench costs almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 但一条长椅几乎不花什么钱。

sentences.en: Sometimes a small place is enough to turn strangers into friends.
sentences.zh: 有时候，一个小地方就足以让陌生人变成朋友。

keyVocab.note: 英式拼写，美式写作 neighborhood
a thermos of tea 一壶茶
公园或路边供人坐的长凳
share sth with sb 与某人分享
由 strange 加 -er 构成

grammar.en: At the gate of our neighbourhood, there is an old wooden bench.
grammar.main: there is an old wooden bench
grammar.subject: there（引导词，真正的主语是 an old wooden bench）
grammar.object: 无宾语（there be 句型表示存在）
grammar.modifiers: At the gate of our neighbourhood 是介词短语，作地点状语，放在句首
grammar.logic: there be 句型先说地点，再说那里存在什么，常用于描写场景
grammar.zh: 在我们小区门口，有一条旧木长椅。

grammar.en: Children do homework on one end, and neighbours share vegetables at the other.
grammar.main: Children do homework, and neighbours share vegetables
grammar.subject: Children / neighbours
grammar.object: homework / vegetables
grammar.modifiers: on one end 和 at the other 是介词短语，表示位置上的对比
grammar.logic: and 连接两个并列分句，一头一尾形成对照，画面感很强
grammar.zh: 孩子们在一头写作业，邻居们在另一头分菜。

grammar.en: Someone even fixed the broken leg last month.
grammar.main: Someone fixed the broken leg
grammar.subject: Someone
grammar.object: the broken leg
grammar.modifiers: even 加强语气；last month 是时间状语
grammar.logic: 简单的主谓宾结构，一般过去时说明这件事已经发生
grammar.zh: 上个月甚至有人把坏掉的椅腿修好了。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How an old bench became a meeting place
How to build a park in a neighbourhood
The daily life of an old man
A busy bus stop in a big city
quiz.evidence: Sometimes a small place is enough to turn strangers into friends.
quiz.explain: 文章从一条无人注意的长椅写起，讲它如何因为一位老人而变成邻里相聚的地方。
whyWrong: 文中提到公园只是用来对比，并没有讲怎么建公园。
老人只是变化的起点，全文重点在长椅和邻里。
公交站只是长椅最初的用途。

quiz.question: What did the old man bring to the bench?
options: A thermos of tea and a radio
quiz.evidence: He brought a thermos of tea and a small radio.
quiz.explain: 原文明确写出他带来一壶茶和一个小收音机。
whyWrong: 文中没有报纸和椅子。
面包和牛奶在文中没有出现。
狗和球是干扰项，文中未提。

quiz.question: Why is the bench busy now?
options: People like to meet and talk there.
The city pays people to sit there.
It is next to a new school.
The bus comes more often than before.
quiz.evidence: Soon other people stopped to talk with him.
quiz.explain: 老人每天坐在那里，别人停下来和他聊天，长椅因此慢慢成了聚人的地方。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到任何补贴。
附近新建学校这一信息不存在。
公交班次的变化在文中没有提及。

quiz.question: What does the writer believe?
options: Small shared places matter a lot.
Parks are a waste of public money.
Neighbours should not talk to strangers.
quiz.evidence: But a bench costs almost nothing.
quiz.explain: 作者承认公园重要，但强调一条几乎不花钱的长椅也能改变邻里关系，可见他看重小型公共空间。
whyWrong: 作者明确说公园很重要。
作者在赞美这条旧长椅，不会主张拆掉。
文章正是在讲邻居从陌生变熟悉。

title: A Library Card

sentences.en: Mia moved to a new town in September.
sentences.zh: 米娅九月搬到了一个新城镇。

sentences.en: She knew nobody there, so her first weekend felt very quiet.
sentences.zh: 她在那里谁也不认识，因此第一个周末过得十分安静。

sentences.en: On Sunday, she noticed a small library near the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 周日，她发现公交车站旁有一家小图书馆。

sentences.en: Inside, a friendly worker helped her get a free library card.
sentences.zh: 进去后，一位友善的工作人员帮她办了一张免费的借书证。

sentences.en: Mia chose a book about local birds and sat by the window.
sentences.zh: 米娅选了一本介绍当地鸟类的书，在窗边坐下。

sentences.en: Another reader asked about the bird on the cover.
sentences.zh: 另一位读者问起封面上的鸟。

sentences.en: They talked for a few minutes and found that they lived on the same street.
sentences.zh: 两人聊了几分钟，发现彼此住在同一条街上。

sentences.en: Before leaving, Mia borrowed the book and checked the date of the next reading group.
sentences.zh: 离开前，米娅借走了这本书，并查看了下一次读书小组活动的日期。

sentences.en: The town still felt new, but it no longer felt quite so lonely.
sentences.zh: 这个城镇仍让她觉得陌生，但已不再那么孤独。

sentences.en: On the way home, she began looking forward to her next visit and another conversation.
sentences.zh: 回家途中，她开始期待下一次到访和下一次交谈。

grammar.en: Inside, a friendly worker helped her get a free library card.
grammar.zh: 进去后，一位友善的工作人员帮她办了一张免费的借书证。
grammar.main: a worker helped her
grammar.subject: a friendly worker
grammar.object: her
grammar.modifiers: Inside 作地点状语；get a free library card 是省略 to 的不定式补语。
grammar.logic: help somebody do something 表示帮助某人做某事。

grammar.en: They talked for a few minutes and found that they lived on the same street.
grammar.zh: 两人聊了几分钟，发现彼此住在同一条街上。
grammar.main: They talked and found something
grammar.subject: They
grammar.object: that 引导的宾语从句
grammar.modifiers: for a few minutes 表示持续时间；on the same street 表示地点。
grammar.logic: and 连接两个动作，that 从句交代发现的内容。

quiz.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: A plan to buy a house
A small step towards feeling at home
quiz.evidence: The town still felt new, but it no longer felt quite so lonely.
quiz.explain: 孤独感减轻呼应图书馆里的交流，说明她开始融入新地方。
whyWrong: 公交车站只是地点信息，并非旅程。
文中没有购房计划。
鸟是谈话契机，并非饲养指南。

quiz.question: What did Mia borrow?
quiz.evidence: Mia chose a book about local birds and sat by the window.
quiz.explain: 她选择了介绍当地鸟类的书，离开时借走了它。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到报纸。
公交车只出现在车站背景里。
文中没有借地图。

quiz.question: What might Mia do in the future?
quiz.evidence: Before leaving, Mia borrowed the book and checked the date of the next reading group.
quiz.explain: 她主动查看下一次读书小组日期，说明可能参加，但文章并未保证她一定参加。
whyWrong: 车站是附近地标，不是居住目标。
她开始建立联系，没有要离开的证据。
文章没有购买图书馆的情节。

source: English Lab 原创教学短文；人物及情境为虚构示例，不代表真实研究或新闻报道

title: Dinner Without a Recipe

sentences.en: Ben wanted to cook dinner, but he could not find his recipe book.
sentences.zh: 本想做晚餐，却找不到食谱书。

sentences.en: He opened the fridge and saw two carrots, an egg, and some rice.
sentences.zh: 他打开冰箱，看见两根胡萝卜、一个鸡蛋和一些米饭。

sentences.en: His sister suggested making a simple bowl of fried rice.
sentences.zh: 妹妹建议做一碗简单的炒饭。

sentences.en: First, Ben washed the carrots and cut them into small pieces.
sentences.zh: 首先，本洗好胡萝卜，把它们切成小块。

sentences.en: His sister heated a little oil in a pan and added the egg.
sentences.zh: 妹妹在锅里热了少许油，然后加入鸡蛋。

sentences.en: They put in the vegetables and rice, then stirred everything together.
sentences.zh: 他们加入蔬菜和米饭，把所有食材翻炒均匀。

sentences.en: The meal was ready before their parents came home.
sentences.zh: 父母回家前，这顿饭就做好了。

sentences.en: It was not a special dish, but everyone enjoyed eating something the children had made.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么特别的菜，但大家都很喜欢吃孩子们做的饭。

sentences.en: Ben wrote down the steps so that he could cook it again next week.
sentences.zh: 本记下了步骤，以便下周再做一次。

sentences.en: He also added a reminder to check the fridge before making a shopping list.
sentences.zh: 他还提醒自己，在列购物清单之前先检查冰箱。

grammar.en: His sister suggested making a simple bowl of fried rice.
grammar.zh: 妹妹建议做一碗简单的炒饭。
grammar.main: His sister suggested making fried rice
grammar.subject: His sister
grammar.object: making a simple bowl of fried rice
grammar.modifiers: making 是动名词，作 suggested 的宾语。
grammar.logic: suggest doing something 表示建议做某事，不能直接接 to do。

grammar.en: Ben wrote down the steps so that he could cook it again next week.
grammar.zh: 本记下了步骤，以便下周再做一次。
grammar.main: Ben wrote down the steps
grammar.subject: Ben
grammar.object: the steps
grammar.modifiers: so that 引导目的状语从句；next week 为时间状语。
grammar.logic: 记步骤是手段，能够再次做饭是目的。

quiz.question: What does Ben learn from cooking dinner?
options: He can make a meal with what is available
Every meal needs an expensive recipe
quiz.evidence: He opened the fridge and saw two carrots, an egg, and some rice.
quiz.explain: 现有的胡萝卜、鸡蛋和米饭足以做出一家人喜欢的晚餐。
whyWrong: 晚餐是本和妹妹合作完成的。
他们正是把蔬菜与米饭一起炒。
他找不到食谱仍做成了饭。

quiz.question: What did Ben do first with the carrots?
options: He put them in the fridge
quiz.evidence: First, Ben washed the carrots and cut them into small pieces.
quiz.explain: First 后明确写了先洗胡萝卜，再切块。
whyWrong: 他记录的是烹饪步骤。
热油是妹妹后续做的步骤。
胡萝卜原本就在冰箱中。

quiz.question: Why did Ben write down the steps?
options: To help himself repeat the meal
To ask his parents to buy a recipe book
To stop his sister from cooking
To count how many carrots were left
quiz.evidence: Ben wrote down the steps so that he could cook it again next week.
quiz.explain: so that 从句说明记步骤是为了下周再做。
whyWrong: 文中没有让父母买书的安排。
他与妹妹合作，没有阻止她。
记录步骤与清点剩余胡萝卜无关。

source: English Lab 原创教学短文；人物及情境为虚构示例，不代表真实研究或新闻报道

title: The Long Way to School

sentences.en: Every morning, Leo took the shortest road to school.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，利奥都走最短的那条路去学校。

sentences.en: The road was busy, and he often waited a long time to cross it.
sentences.zh: 那条路很繁忙，他常常要等很久才能过马路。

sentences.en: One day, a classmate showed him another route beside the river.
sentences.zh: 一天，一位同学带他看了河边的另一条路线。

sentences.en: The river path was longer, but it had no cars and plenty of trees.
sentences.zh: 河边的小路更长，但没有汽车，而且树木很多。

sentences.en: Leo could hear birds instead of engines as he walked.
sentences.zh: 利奥走路时听到的是鸟鸣，而非发动机的声音。

sentences.en: He arrived five minutes later than usual, yet he felt calm and ready for class.
sentences.zh: 他比平时晚到了五分钟，但心情平静，也准备好上课了。

sentences.en: Now he leaves home a little earlier when the weather is fine.
sentences.zh: 如今天气好时，他就稍微早一点出门。

sentences.en: On rainy days, he still takes the short road because the river path gets muddy.
sentences.zh: 下雨天他仍走近路，因为河边的小路会变得泥泞。

sentences.en: For Leo, the best route depends on more than distance alone.
sentences.zh: 对利奥来说，最佳路线取决于距离之外的因素。

sentences.en: He now pays attention to how a journey feels, as well as how long it takes.
sentences.zh: 现在他既留意行程花多长时间，也留意旅途带给自己的感受。

grammar.en: Leo could hear birds instead of engines as he walked.
grammar.zh: 利奥走路时听到的是鸟鸣，而非发动机的声音。
grammar.main: Leo could hear birds
grammar.subject: Leo
grammar.object: birds
grammar.modifiers: instead of engines 表示替代对象；as 引导时间状语从句。
grammar.logic: 主句描述听到的声音，as 从句交代同时发生的动作。

grammar.en: On rainy days, he still takes the short road because the river path gets muddy.
grammar.zh: 下雨天他仍走近路，因为河边的小路会变得泥泞。
grammar.main: he still takes the short road
grammar.subject: he
grammar.object: the short road
grammar.modifiers: On rainy days 是时间状语；because 引导原因状语从句。
grammar.logic: 走近路是结果，河边泥泞是原因。

quiz.question: What is the main idea of the story?
options: A good route involves more than its length
The shortest road is always dangerous
Everyone should walk beside a river
quiz.evidence: For Leo, the best route depends on more than distance alone.
quiz.explain: 末句概括距离不是衡量路线的唯一因素。
whyWrong: 雨天泥泞恰恰使河边路线不合适。
文章没有说所有近路都危险。
路线取决于个人和天气条件。

quiz.question: How much later did Leo arrive by the river path?
quiz.evidence: He arrived five minutes later than usual, yet he felt calm and ready for class.
quiz.explain: 正文明确写到 five minutes later。
whyWrong: 十分钟并非文中给出的差值。
半小时远超文章描述。
文章没有一小时的行程变化。

quiz.question: Why does Leo keep using two different routes?
options: He keeps forgetting the river path
His classmate chooses for him every day
quiz.evidence: On rainy days, he still takes the short road because the river path gets muddy.
quiz.explain: 晴天走河边，雨天走近路，说明他会根据条件选择。
whyWrong: 他清楚两条路线的特点。
同学只是在一天介绍了路线。
学校位置没有发生变化。

source: English Lab 原创教学短文；人物及情境为虚构示例，不代表真实研究或新闻报道

title: A Pool Visit

sentences.en: Chen arrives at the university sports center with his swimming bag.
sentences.zh: 陈带着游泳包来到大学体育中心。

sentences.en: He usually swims on Tuesday mornings, but today the pool door is closed.
sentences.zh: 他通常周二上午游泳，但今天泳池的门关着。

sentences.en: At the front desk, a woman is answering the phone.
sentences.zh: 服务台前，一位女士正在接电话。

sentences.en: Chen waits until she finishes, then asks if the pool is open.
sentences.zh: 陈等她接完电话，然后问泳池是否开放。

sentences.en: The woman explains that a class is using it until ten.
sentences.zh: 女士解释说，有一个班要使用泳池到十点。

sentences.en: Chen looks at his watch; it is half past nine.
sentences.zh: 陈看了看手表，现在是九点半。

sentences.en: He does not want to go home and come back half an hour later.
sentences.zh: 他不想回家，半小时后再回来。

sentences.en: Instead, he asks where he can wait.
sentences.zh: 于是，他问可以在哪里等候。

sentences.en: The woman points to chairs near the window.
sentences.zh: 女士指了指窗边的椅子。

sentences.en: Chen sits down and reads a few pages of his book.
sentences.zh: 陈坐下来读了几页书。

sentences.en: At ten, he puts the book away and walks to the changing room.
sentences.zh: 十点时，他把书收好，走向更衣室。

grammar.en: He usually swims on Tuesday mornings, but today the pool door is closed.
grammar.zh: 他通常周二上午游泳，但今天泳池的门关着。
grammar.main: He usually swims; the pool door is closed
grammar.subject: He；the pool door
grammar.object: 无；closed 为表语
grammar.modifiers: on Tuesday mornings 表示通常的时间；today 表示今天。
grammar.logic: but 连接平时的习惯与今天的情况。

grammar.en: Chen waits until she finishes, then asks if the pool is open.
grammar.zh: 陈等她接完电话，然后问泳池是否开放。
grammar.main: Chen waits, then asks
grammar.subject: Chen
grammar.object: if the pool is open 是 asks 的内容
grammar.modifiers: until she finishes 表示等待持续到她完成为止。
grammar.logic: 先等待，再询问；if 引出是否开放的问题。

quiz.question: What is the story mainly about?
options: Chen waits for the pool to become available
The sports center closes for a week
quiz.evidence: The woman explains that a class is using it until ten.
quiz.explain: 陈得知泳池被班级使用后，在馆内等到十点。
whyWrong: 他没有教游泳课。
文中只是暂时有班级使用泳池。
手表用来看时间，并非购买对象。

quiz.question: How long does Chen need to wait?
quiz.evidence: Chen looks at his watch; it is half past nine.
quiz.explain: 当前九点半，泳池十点可用，因此需要等半小时。
whyWrong: 九点半到十点不是十分钟。
从九点半到十点不到一小时。
从九点半到十点不是两小时。

quiz.question: Why does Chen read near the window?
options: He wants to teach the class
He is waiting inside the center
He has lost his swimming bag
He is looking for his watch
quiz.evidence: The woman points to chairs near the window.
quiz.explain: 他不想往返家中，便在服务台建议的窗边座位等候。
whyWrong: 文中没有他教学的计划。
他带着游泳包到达，没有提到丢失。
他已经用手表看过时间。

source: English Lab 原创教学短文；人物及情境为虚构示例

title: A Better Reading App

sentences.en: Nora is trying a reading app that her friend Dan made for a class project.
sentences.zh: 诺拉正在试用朋友丹为课堂项目制作的阅读应用。

sentences.en: The app shows short English stories and lets readers save new words.
sentences.zh: 应用展示英语短篇故事，也让读者保存生词。

sentences.en: Nora opens a story and starts reading on her tablet.
sentences.zh: 诺拉在平板电脑上打开一篇故事，开始阅读。

sentences.en: When she taps an unfamiliar word, nothing happens.
sentences.zh: 当她轻点一个不认识的词时，什么也没有发生。

sentences.en: Dan shows her a button that opens a dictionary on another page.
sentences.zh: 丹向她展示了一个按钮，点击后会在另一页打开词典。

sentences.en: Nora finds the meaning, but she loses her place in the story.
sentences.zh: 诺拉找到了释义，却忘记了故事读到哪里。

sentences.en: Dan watches her and writes down what happened.
sentences.zh: 丹观察着她，记下了发生的情况。

sentences.en: He asks what would make reading easier.
sentences.zh: 他问怎样才能让阅读更方便。

sentences.en: Nora says she wants to see the meaning without leaving the text.
sentences.zh: 诺拉说她想在不离开正文的情况下查看释义。

sentences.en: Dan plans to show a small explanation beside the word.
sentences.zh: 丹计划在单词旁边显示简短解释。

sentences.en: He will ask Nora to try the new version before making further changes.
sentences.zh: 在做进一步修改之前，他会请诺拉试用新版本。

grammar.en: When she taps an unfamiliar word, nothing happens.
grammar.zh: 当她轻点一个不认识的词时，什么也没有发生。
grammar.main: nothing happens
grammar.subject: nothing
grammar.object: 无
grammar.modifiers: when 引导时间状语从句；unfamiliar 修饰 word。
grammar.logic: 先交代轻点单词的动作，再说明其结果。

grammar.en: Nora says she wants to see the meaning without leaving the text.
grammar.zh: 诺拉说她想在不离开正文的情况下查看释义。
grammar.main: Nora says (that) she wants to see the meaning
grammar.subject: Nora；从句主语 she
grammar.object: 省略 that 的宾语从句；the meaning 是 see 的宾语
grammar.modifiers: without leaving the text 表示不离开正文；without 后接动词 ing 形式。
grammar.logic: 主句引出诺拉的想法，从句说明她的需求。

quiz.question: What is the main idea of the story?
options: A reader helps improve an app
quiz.evidence: Dan plans to show a small explanation beside the word.
quiz.explain: 诺拉试用并提出需求，丹据此计划改进查词体验。
whyWrong: 丹计划继续改进项目。
诺拉使用词典，没有编写词典。
问题是查词需要离开正文，不是设备故障。

quiz.question: What happens when Nora taps an unfamiliar word?
quiz.evidence: When she taps an unfamiliar word, nothing happens.
quiz.explain: 正文直接说明轻点单词后没有反应。
whyWrong: 此处没有说点击后自动保存。
点击时没有出现翻译。
平板没有因此关机。

quiz.question: Why does Dan plan to show an explanation beside the word?
options: To help Nora stay with the text
quiz.evidence: Nora says she wants to see the meaning without leaving the text.
quiz.explain: 诺拉希望查词时不离开正文，旁边显示解释回应了这个需求。
whyWrong: 改动针对查词过程，不是增加篇幅。
他没有计划删除英文单词。
他没有提出限制平板使用。

source: English Lab 原创教学短文；人物及情境为虚构示例
